locale.description: Locale code. Available: en. Defaults to "en".

status.description: Document status. Defaults to "draft" when draftAndPublish is enabled.

sort.description: Sort expression. String: "field:asc". Array: ["field:asc"]. Object: { field: "asc" }. Valid fields: id, title, markdownContent, authorName, slug, createdAt, updatedAt, documentId.

filters.description: Filter object. Supports logical operators ($and, $or, $not) and field operators ($eq, $ne, $in, $contains, $gt, $lt, etc.). Valid fields: id, title, markdownContent, authorName, slug, createdAt, updatedAt, documentId.
